scenes.setting: Contract signed, ten pounds advanced, four o'clock appointment set — and a cold steak wolfed down after the client finally leaves
scenes.text_anchor: After signing a contract with Millet Carter and receiving an advance payment of ten pounds

scenes.setting: Two o'clock: red-eyed Mary confirms the photo, pays the last seven pounds, and storms out with Stelyn struggling to keep up
scenes.text_anchor: “You're the most efficient and responsible detective I've ever met.

scenes.setting: A nap, then the map: Williams Street sits at the border of West and Empress Boroughs — a former viscount's property worth thousands
scenes.text_anchor: Williams Street was at the border of the West Borough and Empress Borough

scenes.setting: Unit 8 Williams Street, mid-renovation: Millet leads the 'assistant-less' detective to the basement's exposed gray stone door; lantern in hand, Klein enters a stone passageway of rotting ostentatious doors
scenes.text_anchor: “There's a secret door over there. It was discovered by the workers when they were renovating.”

scenes.setting: Beyond the black bifold door: a ten-meter nest of writhing snakes — snake-phobic Klein pleads for help and Miss Bodyguard's arctic wind scatters and frosts them; the upside-down candlesticks suggest a Fourth Epoch structure
scenes.text_anchor: It was a snake with a triangular head and red floral patterns on its head!
